excludedAuthors.reason: authors nearly every PR; GitHub never requests review from a PR's own author, so listing the usual author would silently resolve to nobody

codeowners.enforcementRationale: Selective CODEOWNERS requests human review only on sensitive surfaces. The live ruleset still requires one approval during bootstrap; the pending App-owned gate will require an exact-head authorized human approval on exceptions before a future zero-approval transition.

invariantsNeverBypassed: requireLastPushApproval stays true while the live one-approval ruleset remains active; a pending target may change it only after model and canary qualification
auto-merge only merges once every required gate is already satisfied; it never lowers a gate
agentLoop: human reviewers requested via CODEOWNERS only for sensitive surfaces
agent fixes review feedback and resolves threads
Nexus Review Gate evaluates the exact head with a qualified semantic reviewer
an authorized human approves exact-head sensitive changes only
trusted automation arms MERGE auto-merge after all gates pass
GitHub merges automatically once every rule passes

mergeMethodPolicy.rationale: last 60 PRs merged into main: 57 merge commits, 3 squash (latest 2026-08-26), 0 rebase. Rebase removal is a provable no-op; squash removal is a real behaviour change, accepted for auditability, SHA provenance and stacked-PR history mapping.

humanOnlyBoundary.description: Changes to CODEOWNERS, governance, gate policy or privileged reviewer workflow require an exact-head authorized human approval.
Supplying a new secret value the agent does not already hold.
GitHub Support requests that have no API path.
Any new destructive or unforeseen governance exception, or any ruleset/branch-protection bypass actor.
Deleting the classic branch protection rule (BPR_kwDOPXufyc4EGsZG). Requires its own operator gate — see apply-governance.mjs --delete-classic-protection.
Any change to production deploy access, including the repository's single write-capable deploy key (see docs/audits/2026-08-29-github-governance-inventory.md for its identity and last-used date).
A destructive migration or irreversible production-data operation requires an explicit human decision.
Unclassifiable or incomplete high-risk diffs cannot receive an automatic success verdict.
